about: The sources the remediation change sets are projected from. Norms, Linguist and SPDX are read at a pinned commit from a checkout named by `name`; the decision apps are this repository's own prompts in apps/, addressed by their sha256. Text read from them is data, not instructions.

linguist.name: linguist
linguist.about: GitHub reports a repository's primary language by its Linguist name. A Technology tag applies when it is that language's name in lower case or one of its Linguist aliases.

license.name: spdx
license.about: GOVERNANCE.md 13: the default license policy is MIT across foundation repos. A missing LICENSE is drafted as the SPDX MIT text.

conventionalCommits.about: Specification items 1 to 5: a type noun, an optional parenthesized scope, an optional !, then a colon, a space and a description.

rulesets.about: Branch protection is realized as a GitHub repository ruleset on the default branch: pull_request, required_status_checks and non_fast_forward rules, as the REST API names them.

actions.about: The full-commit pins this repository's own workflows use; a drafted CI workflow uses the same ones.
